title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: Reorganize tests by runtime, frontend, build and compiled artifacts; preserve the existing regressions and add account lifecycle, password reveal, statistics detection and embedded-font coverage. Update CI and automatic frontend discovery.

Centralize shared settings contracts and native WG enums without changing defaults or JSON formats. Reuse colour and numeric helpers, remove unused game utilities and redundant test imports, and refresh development documentation.
BETA NOTICE: the settings panel is still under construction. Layouts and live previews may contain errors; full visual acceptance in the Gameface client is pending.

Fix intermittent Account Manager clipping with a fullscreen modal viewport and CSS centering; focus the panel and capture Escape before internal controls. Show a mask for saved passwords, reveal them only on request, preserve unchanged passwords on save, and draw checkbox ticks in CSS independently of font glyphs. Build and Gameface regression checks pass; the user confirmed the fixes in the NA client.

Adopt the reference vehicle-marker defaults; preserve installed personal profiles and legacy text origins. Match Python and preview geometry, cache text layers per state, and keep recreated health bars below labels.

Keep fonts self-contained in Flash and Gameface, preserving dkm and existing aliases. Remove OpenWG Common and its Python font registration package to avoid unrelated GPU settings, FPS limits and native modules. The user reports working fonts and no observed lag in the NA client after removal; a controlled FPS comparison remains pending.
Replace the symbol-font resource with the supplied DriftkingsFont.ttf, using dkm as the configurable font name and preserving the original glyphs and legacy font aliases in Flash and Gameface.

Keep roster view discovery active across empty loading-to-battle transitions so player-panel statistics can resume. Disable integrated marker distances by default to leave the dedicated target-distance module as the sole distance renderer.
Fix vehicle-marker property editing and expose rating settings. Align the two fictional carousel preview cards with the native horizontal layout and the live renderer.
Add carousel hit-rate and zero-mark icons, separate actual and expected damage colours, and keep mixed numeric/macro settings editable without hiding the carousel page.
Centralize shared constants and marker contracts while preserving Python 2.7, native WG enums, public names, settings keys and payload formats.
Reduce redundant statistics processing and settings reads, validate settings drafts before publication, and skip identical Gameface payloads and preview redraws.
Reuse battle calculations and minimap data; improve callback ownership, arena guards, event subscription rollback and carousel lifecycle cleanup.

Fix the inverted minimap gun-arc sector by compensating both custom sector lines by 180 degrees while preserving the camera direction. Verified in game; geometry and yaw-limit regression tests pass on Python 2.7 and Python 3.
Recognize Halloween difficulties (bonus types 101-103) as a separate battle mode. Add team-panel mode adapters; preserve random-battle panels and leave unsupported modes to the native client.

Colour native Halloween TAB player names by the configured rating, without the extra statistics table in the upper-left corner. Restore original colours on hide or when statistics are unavailable; keep the native event values, side panel and loading screen unchanged.

Fix late Halloween TAB hook ownership so the registered hooks run under the active team-panels component. Add regression checks with the real hook registry and native-name colour restoration. In-game acceptance of the new name colours remains pending.

Add regression coverage for battle-mode detection, native Halloween screen isolation, allies-only ordering, and 15v15/30v30 rosters. Core, settings-panel and Gameface checks pass; no new release or game installation is implied by the source integration.

Use Gameface-compatible style.color access for native Halloween TAB name colours. Avoid unsupported CSS priority APIs and add a regression case with the limited client style API; no additional panel or text nodes are created.
Refresh documentation, remove obsolete reports and generated local artifacts, and update isolated test fixtures for the current contracts. No quantitative FPS gain is claimed.
Target WoT 2.4.1.1 on EU, NA and ASIA. Preserve existing personal settings and keep stable 0.1.3 unchanged.
